status: Low-parameter all-angle calibrated model; inspect MODEL_REPORT failures, no blanket success certificate
control_map: a,b,eta,lambda,epsilon constants. Five Vc,Vs,t0,tc,ts=A+B*r², r=sin(theta/2)/sin(1.5deg). Endpoint controls are an invertible reparameterization of the same15 coefficients.
energy_convention: Only Gamma-relative dispersion: reference/model each subtract their own lowest Gamma energy once for the complete path. No absolute inter-angle band-edge prediction.
model_default_cutoff: Same fixed integer hexagonal shell5 at every angle; no exact-angle Q switches.
source_Q_interface: source_hamiltonian(theta,k) returns exact native source-Q matrix only at configured angles/rounded aliases; this is the calibration and raw native-overlap space.
source_overlap_qualification: Exact L(k) at3.89; source-only Gamma/M/K frame approximation at other angles, actual capture floors retained. No larger-Q native-overlap certificate.
offgrid_scope: Geometry-only interpolation of B/sin(theta/2), fixed analytic coefficient curves; unvalidated between source angles.
geometry_inputs: Actual per-angle reciprocal cell and exact ordered native Q, frozen geometry only.
Kramers_labels: Anchor-connected Kramers channels; internal Pauli generator is not asserted to be physical spin.
